title: Normalized ordinary tensor comparison data at an independent coefficient size
statement: For essentially small sites C,D, a continuous functor U:C→D, commutative ring sheaves R,S at an independent coefficient size r, a structural map R→U_*S and an additive adjunction F⊣U_*, ordinary tensor pullback data consists of isomorphisms F(M⊗N)≅FM⊗FN, their scalar-generator formula and naturality, and preservation of K-flat complexes having flat terms. The sheafified pure tensor is the image of the sectionwise pure tensor under the sheafification unit followed by the canonical comparison with the localization tensor. The normalization and flatness fields are propositions. No existence is asserted by this definition. [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]
